app_context.key_feature: Dynamic 6-Theme UI Reskinning via CSS Custom Properties & data-theme attributes

theme_architecture.mechanism: Global html[data-theme="<theme_id>"] CSS attribute selector controlling root variables and surface modifiers

shared_class_vocabulary..vesper-glass: Primary card/panel surface modifier adaptively styled per theme (glassmorphism, paper card, brutalist box, crt screen, film container, bubble pill)
shared_class_vocabulary..vesper-display: Typography utility class for major headings and titles, applying theme display font family & weight
shared_class_vocabulary..vesper-mono: Typography utility class for badges, metadata, episode labels, tech info using mono or serif theme fonts
shared_class_vocabulary.[data-focused=\"true\"]: D-pad focused state applied to active TV element

settings_theme_picker.description: Grid of 6 interactive preview cards showcasing real-time UI re-skinning
requirements: Include mini-home preview thumbnail for each skin
Highlight currently active skin with distinct focused border
Ensure theme selection instantaneously updates html[data-theme] and stores preference in localStorage
Provide testid attribute data-testid="theme-card-<theme-id>" for automated tests

home_billboard_hero.description: 10-foot TV hero section featuring active title preview, backdrop media, metadata chips, and primary action buttons (Play, Trailer, Add to Watchlist)
home_billboard_hero.focus_rules: Hero CTAs must adopt theme-specific focus styles when selected via D-pad

poster_shelf.description: Horizontal scrollable media rows featuring PosterTile cards
poster_shelf.focus_rules: Selected PosterTile scales according to theme parameters, auto-scrolls into viewport center, and updates hero backdrop preview

left_sidenav.description: Navigation rail with Search, Home, Movies, TV Shows, Library, Settings icons and labels
left_sidenav.tv_behavior: Collapsed rail expands on D-pad Left focus, highlighting active item with theme nav_focus style

player_overlay.description: Native-style TV video player controls, scrub bar, chapter markers, and audio/subtitle drawer
player_overlay.tv_behavior: D-pad interaction reveals theme-reskinned control overlay with focusable play/pause/scrub controls

dpad_navigation_rules.spatial_navigation: Logical 4-way direction navigation (Up, Down, Left, Right, Select/OK, Back)
dpad_navigation_rules.auto_scroll: Focused tile must trigger smooth scroll animation to keep target centered within TV safe bounds
dpad_navigation_rules.safe_zones: 5% outer overscan margin (p-8 to p-12) to prevent content cutoff on hardware TV screens
dpad_navigation_rules.focus_attributes: Every interactive element MUST maintain data-focused="true/false" and appropriate data-focus-style attribute

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="nav-settings", data-testid="poster-tile-1", data-testid="player-play-btn")
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standards: All skins maintain > 4.5:1 text contrast for body copy and > 3:1 for large display headlines
accessibility_and_testing.performance_optimization: Backdrop blur styles fall back gracefully to semi-opaque solid backgrounds on lower-powered TV processors

instructions_to_main_agent: Load all 6 Google Fonts families in index.html or index.css.
Implement the theme manager in a React context (ThemeContext.js) that toggles the `data-theme` attribute on document.documentElement.
Do NOT create TypeScript files (.tsx), use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx).
Ensure every clickable/focusable card or button has proper keyboard/D-pad event listeners (KeyDown Enter/Space) and data-testid attributes.
Style surfaces using .vesper-glass, headings with .vesper-display, labels with .vesper-mono for universal skin adaptability.
